context: Naoko complains about a delivery truck blocking her shop; Kenji listens.
purpose: Aunt venting about everyday nuisance naturally.

lines.speaker: naoko_aunt
lines.jp: けんちゃん、トラックが、店の前、塞いでしもた!
lines.en: Ken-chan, a truck blocked the front of the shop!
lines.style: animated Kansai aunt voice, bright warm exasperated delivery carefully

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: えっ、バックして、どけてもらえへんの?
lines.en: Eh — can't they back up and move?
lines.style: soft Kansai man voice, warm engaged delivery carefully

lines.speaker: naoko_aunt
lines.jp: かなり、長い時間、止まってんねん。
lines.en: It's been parked there a good while.
lines.style: frustrated Kansai aunt voice, bright warm honest delivery carefully

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.style: gentle Kansai man voice, soft warm sympathetic delivery carefully

lines.speaker: naoko_aunt
lines.jp: 正面以外、入口、ないからな。
lines.en: There's no entrance besides the front.
lines.style: soft Kansai aunt voice, warm honest delivery carefully

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 俺、運転手さんに、声かけてみるわ。
lines.en: I'll go talk to the driver.
lines.style: warm Kansai man voice, soft warm helpful delivery carefully

lines.speaker: naoko_aunt
